target_of_evaluation: DLI course source and repository CI definitions
course JavaScript, HTML, CSS, images, and locale overlays executed by the learner browser
external_context: source host and CI execution service
system.ownership_rule: Only Target of Evaluation entries are course-owned components. Every external-context participant is outside repository ownership and has no verified live controls in this diagram.

threat_enumeration.rule: Enumerate threats only for the declared edges and only for each edge's listed security objectives. Do not infer additional flows from external context.
threat_enumeration.route_consolidation: Direct and operator-relayed variants from course client code to the same external service remain one Target of Evaluation boundary flow.
objective_rules: Confidentiality is not a security objective for public course source, released static assets, or public asset delivery.
Integrity applies to course source, build output, published assets, browser code, and sensitive service messages.
Availability applies to course validation, publication, asset delivery, and the learner-visible integration boundary; external service capacity remains operator-owned.

excluded_external_interactions.reason: External startup orchestration outside course ownership; the learner-visible runtime boundary is browser_to_nemoclaw

excluded_external_interactions.interaction: external launchable to external model service
excluded_external_interactions.reason: Not a course route; model requests originate from course client code even when startup supplies the credential
